nom: Kopari Beauty Star Bright Vitamin C Discoloration Correcting Serum

avis.texte: Purchased 2 times, finishing my second bottle. After consistent use, my skin hasnt looked this clear and bright in a very long time! I never leave reviews but this one I had to

avis.titre: Gets rid of texture and scarring
avis.texte: Out of all my face care routine I would consider this the essential, non negotiable well worth the price! Gentle but effective. Over a few months it has reduced my acne scars, texture and dark spots tremendously. I can go without makeup! 100 rec!!!
So far I like this product Usually I have a reaction from products with vitamin C

avis.titre: No results and dropper does not work well
avis.texte: I have been using this product for 3 months now and do not see any change in my skin. Also the dropper does not pick up product very well. I have switched to another vitamin C product by Timeless that works better and I've noticed brighter skin after using it.
I like the product - it's gentle and was quickly effective with discoloration but the dispenser is hard to pick up product and the bottle is not lasting long when used twice a day.

I've tried a few vitamin C serums before but honestly this one feels the best on my skin. No crazy smell, and you need the SMALLEST amount, it goes a long way. People have commented my skin looks "porcelain" after using this serum regularly. It'a worth trying for the price.

Works fine but the packaging is annoying. The dropper doesnt pick up the product well and when it finally picks something up it gets too much. Its clear so i would think its easy to tell but its misleading.

This serum is amazing! A little goes a long way. It absorbs beautifully and the tiny beads within it melt easily, leaving your face looking dewy and glowy! Smells divine too! Just placed another order for this wonderful serum!
The little beads break up and then they leave their shell on your face not fun very disappointed with this purchase return
Absorbs immediately by the skin and it feels nice. I live it citric smell as well. I have to wait to see if the skin is improving.
My skin feels so soft and look so much brighter! I actually just repurchased a new bottle when it went on sale for the 21 days of beauty!
I love this ptoduct and have repurchased a few times. Great results, no sensitivity and works great with my products. Pair with the vit c moisturizer and SPF for best results. I use 2x daily.
I really like this product. It makes my face feel so moisturized ! Then, there is it's fragrance, it is WONDERFUL!

I love how its blend with my skin, very effective and good absorption with smooth texture and there is no strong scent. My skin is so much more even toned and healthy looking. I will forever repurchase!

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C for oily skin
avis.texte: I have tried the vitamin C's from Natrurium and Clinique both did nothing for me. I was determined to get the glow and address my hyperpigmentation so off the recommendation of an Ulta employee, I purchased the Kopari vitamin C and I'm in love. The serum has small beads in there and it smells like oranges. It goes on well not sticky and immediately brightens my skin all day long and I have oily skin. It doesn't bleed into my eyes. It doesn't make me shiny yet it brightens up my skin and my sun spots on my forehead have faded dramatically. While I know something that works for me may not work for you. This is definitely worth a try! I am on my second bottle and will continue to use this. I love it so much.

I was looking for vitamin c serums to help fade my pregnancy melasma. I also wanted to try kakadu plum in a serum. Id never tried this brand before. Ive been using it every night for a few weeks now, and I definitely notice my melasma fading. It has a pleasant citrus scent. It hasnt irritated my sensitive skin. Its a bit pricey, but i will likely repurchase after i finish the bottle.
I have scarring from a detox and started this right after the break out and almost done with the bottle and I don't really see a difference

I use this serum in combination with the Star Bright Moisturizer and the Marine Clean gel cleanser. My skin has gotten clearer and smoother. All the hyperpigmentation spots are fading, and my complexion has started to glow! I have deep brown, combination skin. The serum and moisturizer have lasted for over two months and were used twice per day.

avis.titre: My forehead melasma is almost gone
avis.texte: I've had melasma for years and my forehead was super stubborn. I decided to change my vitamin C skincare routine and found Kopari Star Bright in my research. Almost done with my first bottle and my forehead melasma is almost gone. I ordered another bottle and will also try the moisturizer. I hope this product stays around forever.
I have a lot of acne scarring and hyperpigmentation on my face. I came across this product and after using it for 30 days, it did nothing for me. My scars are still visible, and I see no improvement.
I love this stuff, my face is brighter and so much smoother. Will order again!
Love this product! Makes my face so soft and smooth. Yes, to discoloration correction. Wished I had taken before pic!

Being in my 50's, with sun damaged skin.. this is the first serum I've used that actually works! Within two weeks, I noticed a difference! My skin was brighter, less blotchy looking. I'm very pleased with this product!
It is top tier. My skin responds in a positive way. I tried several different brands of Vit C. This is it .😁
I use this every morning and it always makes me feel awake and refreshed with the delicious smell of citrus! I love the way it makes my face feel💛

I liked it..it smelled great! A few suggestions though would be to have it with a pump instead of a dropper...it doesn't work that well. Also it is kind of sticky on my face after applying but eventually smoothed out.
I love the way the serum soaks in and the way it makes my skin feel.
I love it. I apply it at night after I cleanse my face Really good results!!!
I wear it every day and it's great for summer. This a terrific serum.

avis.titre: The best vitamin C discoloration correcting serum
avis.texte: I've been using this kopari for about 3 weeks, and I must say I love everything about it. Great for discoloration, smells good, and it doesn't break me out like other brands have. I am 10 months postpartum and my face is going through hormonal acne + I have oily skin, and this is definitely a life saver for my dark spots, although its a bit pricey but its a must have.
Just one more fabulous product, I love the glow it is giving my face.

avis.titre: The First Vit C Serum I can use with NO Irritation
avis.texte: My skin is loving this serum, from the forst time I used it my skin just glows. Unlike the other high priced Vitamin C serums ive tried this did not irritate my sesative skin. Plus ots not sticky and has no smell which I appreciate. Plus the glass bottke do i can see whtn im running low. I only knew Kopari ftom the spf now I cannot wait to try the orher skincare. Highly Reccomend for Sensitive Skin

Holy Smokes. This Vitamin C serum is first off GORGEOUS and secondly incredibly effective. I just love how unique it looks and how firm and bright my skin feels after using. I received a sample in store and I cannot wait to purchase a full size!
Needed this to jump start a new look at getting to the bottom of some discoloration on my cheeks. Using faithfully.
What better way to work on discoloration than with VitC. Whatever reason we get discoloration doesn't matter, what matters is that we can treat it with success.
I've been using it for a week now and I can see the results already. It has gotten better and brighter . I love the scent of it as well!

this is such a fun product to use! the texture is enjoyable and makes it easy to look forward to the product. the capsules burst open upon massaging into skin, offering that "skintertainment" aspect (as well as helping with ingredient stability). The formula offers a trio of stabilized vitamin c, niacinamide, and tranexamic acid for brightening. i can speak only in terms of the impact this had on some PIH (as hyperpigmentation varies quite a lot), but I did see my spots improve with use of this serum. overall, i'm very pleased with this release and think it could have added value for those who struggle to look forward to their routines.
This has really been a game changer for my skin. I am acne prone and it works well with my skin. I have defiantly noticed an improvement in my overall glowy-ness of my skin. I would highly recommend.

I've used lots of vitamin c serums before and my combo oily skin is picky with them. This one is absolutely perfect for me. The texture is gel-like and easy to apply. It absorbs quickly and leave my skin looking hydrated, but not greasy! There is no irritation at all. This has a gorgeous citrus scent to it also!

I really loved how well Star Bright Vitamin C Discoloration Correcting Serum worked on my skin. I have some discoloration and hyperpigmentation spots that didn't respond to other products so I was skeptical about this serum. But I was wrong because I have only been using it for a month and I can see a big difference. My skin is brighter and the dark spots have begun to fade away. I am so happy to have found something that really works. The only downside is the applicator it wasn't the best or easy to use, but I will still use it.

I absolutely loved the bottle the product came in, I loved how you could see through the glass container and see how beautiful the serum looked. When I applied the serum it absorbed rather quickly which was nice and left my skin feeling smooth. I definitely noticed my skin was brighter and appeared more healthy after using the serum for a week or so. I loved how it smelled too!!

This is a very unique serum. Right away I was enchanted by the beads inside the serum. When I put the serum on my face I loved the thick like texture and there was a light orange like scent. You really do need only 2-3 drops of this. This amount covered all of my face and my neck. After a few weeks (2-3) I noticed a brighter complexion and the most impressive results I got from seeing it on my neck. It lightens dark spots and it makes your skin smooth, soft, and plump.

Kopari's Vitamin C serum totally boosted my skin's hydration game, giving it this awesome glow and making it feel way smoother. It's like it had my back, enhancing my skin's natural barrier and leaving me with an all-around healthier complexion.
The serum smells great and the serum feels wonderful on the skin. The packaging is beautiful and looks very high end. You will not be disappointed by the results.

I used this product religiously, day and night, for one month. The light, citrus scent is so inviting when you first open the bottle. Then the softness as it glides over your skin is just a delicious feeling. The thing that solidified my love of this product though is that it really works. Since the birth of my daughter 6 years ago, I've had what looked like a mustache. It was a hormonal response causing an increase in melanin on my upper lip. I've tried a dozen products at least, and this is the only one that faded that area to where it's nearly gone. I'm impressed and am committed to this brand now.

avis.titre: I love this Vitamin C Serum
avis.texte: This Vitimin C Serum worked great. I have used it for a month and my pores are visibly smaller, skin smoother, lightened dark spots, and more even skin tones. I received compliments from colleagues that my skin had a glow as if I had gone on a vacation. I use it together with Kopari Vitamin C Moisturizer.

The Kopari Star Bright Vitamin C Discoloration Correcting Serum is a Yes gem in my skincare collection. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling smooth and rejuvenated. After using it for a few weeks, I noticed a significant improvement in the overall tone and texture of my skin. Even my mom, who is quite picky about skincare products, was impressed by the results. This serum is a must-have for anyone looking to fade dark spots and achieve a more even complexion. Thank you, Kopari, for creating such an amazing product!
I love this serum! It smells amazing and is such a great first step in my morning skincare routine. 10/10 recommend
This serum feels so luxurious and the little beads feel like it's really working. I noticed results after just one month!

I have to say, I love this product! My skin would drink this serum! It made my face feel plump and well hydrated. It definitely improved the texture of my skin. The jelly balls inside the jar are fun! They dissolve easily and are absorbed immediately.

With its remarkable ability to fade dark spots, brighten the complexion, and deliver noticeable results, it's truly a game-changer. If a friend of mine is searching for a solution to skincare woes, I would totally recommend this product.

I LOVE this serum and use it daily. The smell is fresh & citrusy and makes for an enjoyable application as part of my morning skincare routine. The serum really sinks into my skin and keeps my face hydrated and silky smooth all day long! 10/10 would recommend
